watches.name: Garage Hira Overspray Monocompax
watches.description: Race in the Future Cyberpunk futurism defines the Overspray's hand-painted two-tone dial — a dystopian-racing aesthetic that feels pulled from a world a few decades ahead. Sharp cyber-like angles, unique indices, and the bold placement of the Garage Hira / Overspray signage pull the asymmetry of the monocompax design into something that works entirely on its own terms. Illuminate the Night Hand lumed with BGW9 luminescence with C1 lumed hands ensures optimal readability in any lighting condition. Attention to Detail The custom-designed crown boasts a tire tread grip and rally-style wheel face, appealing to the gearhead in all of us. This screw-down, double-gasket crown guarantees water resistance up to 200 meters (20 ATM). Handcrafted Excellence Not only is the dial hand crafted, but the case back is laser engraved in house and the Italian leather strap with laser engraved tri-circle design as well. We work with premium leather from these tanneries: • Himeji Kurozan Leather in Himeji, Japan. Historically, this leather was utilized in the production of samurai armor, benefiting from its exceptional durability and resistance to friction. Today, it continues to be used in traditional martial arts equipment, such as kendo armor, and has also found applications in luxury accessories and watch straps like ours. • The renowned La Perla Azzurra tannery in Santa Croce sull'Arno, Italy. Established in 1970, La Perla Azzurra is a founding member of the "Vera Pelle Italiana Conciata al Vegetale" consortium, specializing in high-quality vegetable-tanned leathers. Specifications • Dimensions: 43mm case diameter, 48mm lug-to-lug, 20mm lug width. • Case: 316L stainless steel with brushed and polished accents. • Water Resistance: Up to 200 meters (20 ATM) with a screw-down crown. • Crystal: Sapphire double dome with anti-reflective coating. • Dial: Handmade, hand painted and hand lumed in house with BGW9 for the indices as well as C1 for the hands. • Movement: Seiko VK-64 mecha-quartz, enclosed behind an inhouse matched to the dial vibe artwork case back. • Strap: Handmade leather strap finished in an Italian linear brushed asphalt black leather with asymmetrical stitching. Standard length: 120mm/75mm, tapering from 20mm to 18mm at the laser-engraved shield buckle. Custom lengths available upon request. • Carry Case: Includes a black hard travel case with handmade placard.

watches.name: Aevum Type-00 Super-lite Titanium GMT Automatic Watch
watches.description: Introducing the Aevum Type-00 Super-lite Titanium Automatic - a stunning timepiece that is truly one-of-a-kind. With a case, case back and chapter ring crafted from all grade 5 titanium and meticulously handmade on a lathe, this watch brings Aevum into brand new level of craftsmanship and quality. Powered by the reliable NH-34 automatic GMT movement, you'll be able to track two timezones with ease. The racing-inspired Italian leather strap and carbon fiber dial give it a sleek, sporty feel while the hand torched titanium chapter ring and case back add a unique touch of character. This watch is a striking combination of style and performance! NOTE: We will absolutely be bringing out more Type-00 handmade Super-lite titanium timepieces, but as we are making them on a lathe, they will appear on the site as they are completed vs as a large stock. Type-00 models are made in a similar configuration, but each is uniquely different - each Type-00 is made with technical drawings ONLY for the internal housing and sealing of the movement - all exterior conturing is done in the moment. Full Aevum Type-00 Super-lite Titanium GMT Automatic specifications: Dimensions: Dimensions: 40.5mm wide x 47mm lug to lug, 20mm lug width, 15.5mm thick on the wrist (including sapphire crystal in measurement) Case: Handmade lathe turned Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5 titanium. Movement: NH-34 automatic 4 hand GMT movement with a 41 hour power reserve. Water resistance: 10ATM is our estimate currently. We're still in the process of developing our own pressure tester but the current design for water resistance includes a 20ATM rated 0.8mm compression rear gasket, 20ATM rated crystal gasket and 20ATM rated tripple gasket screw down crown. This specific watch is also the first Aevum to have a screw down case back instead of a bolt down which adds some additional compression leverage. Crystal: thick double domed and high chamfered sapphire crystal with blue tinge anti-reflection coating. Dial: Woven carbon fiber with bespoke dark chrome indices and hands. 2x Super Luminova BGW9 (blue glow) lumed indices, hands and date window. Custom black date wheel with blue numerals. Crown: 7mm Aevum double-wrench artwork and high grip knurled crown. Screw down tripple gasket design. Case back: Handmade lathe turned screw down case back with hand torched purple finish. Leather strap: The Type-00 Super-lite Titanium Automatic comes with one 100% handmade by us in-house leather strap. Leather carry case: All Type-00 Super-lite Titanium Automatics come with a beautiful hand made by us leather carry case that's matched to your watch strap and stitch colour.

watches.name: Aevum Type-02 Turbo Fan titanium automatic
watches.description: The Aevum Type-02 Turbo Fan channels the raw soul of Group B rallying. The aerodisk wheel, the heat-scorched metal, the feeling of something pushed right to the edge of what's possible. The grade 5 titanium case is hand-cut on a lathe and hand-brushed, while the grade 2 titanium chapter ring is hand torched to produce its signature iridescent heat bloom. A colour no machine can replicate and no two rings will ever share. The white brass dial is made entirely in-house. Hand brushed, hand painted with a bold racing stripe cutting across the face, and hand lumed with Nemoto BGW9. A dial that feels like it has always existed somewhere in motorsport history. Paired with a Kurozan urushi tipped Japanese leather strap and an NH35 automatic movement, the Type-02 doesn't just tell time; it tells you something about the hands that made it. NOTE: We will absolutely be bringing out more Type-01 handmade Super-lite titanium timepieces, but as we are making them on a lathe, they will appear on the site as they are completed vs as a large stock. Type-01 models are made in a similar configuration, but each is uniquely different - each Type-01 is made with technical drawings ONLY for the internal housing and sealing of the movement - all exterior contouring is done in the moment. Full Aevum Type-02 Turbo Fan Titanium Automatic specifications: Dimensions: 41.5mm wide x 47mm lug to lug, 20mm lug width, 13.8mm thick on the wrist (including sapphire crystal in measurement). Case: Handmade lathe turned Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5 titanium. Movement: NH-35 automatic 3 hand movement with a 41 hour power reserve. Water resistance: estimated low at 10ATM until we purchase a pressure tester that can exceed 10ATM, however these utilize a 20ATM capable 0.8mm rear compression gasketed with triple screw down crowns so we suspect they'll perform at a much higher ATM rating, we just can't confirm the numbers yet. Crystal: thick double domed and high chamfered sapphire crystal with blue tinge anti-reflection coating. Dial: In-house hand made and hand brushed turbo fan design with dark chrome hands. Completely lumed by hand with Nemoto BGW9 (blue glow). Crown: 7mm Aevum double-wrench artwork and high grip knurled crown. Screw down triple gasket design. Case back: Handmade lathe turned screw down case back with hand torched blue finish that locks down a 0.8mm compression gasket for water resistance. Leather strap: The Type-02 Turbo Fan Titanium Automatic comes with one 100% handmade by us in-house Japanese urushi tipped leather strap with quick release spring bars. It is tapered from 20mm to 18mm at the laser engraved Aevum buckle. - NOTE - This also includes another handmade strap in the pricing~ Carry case: All Type-02 Turbo Fan Super-lite Titanium Automatics come with a ABS plastic travel box with an in-house laser engraved top plate.

watches.name: Track Tech Chronograph
watches.description: When you take a great watch such as the Track Tech and make a new dial/hand set for it like the Carbon Limited version, you can't help but wonder what other creations you can make with the additional components. Well, here's one creation brought to life! This very limited version of the Track Tech is called 'Frost and Pink' and it combines the frost dial of the original Track Tech chronograph with the hand set of the purple/pink Carbon Limited. The original black painted Track Tech hands are removed in-house and changed over to the Carbon Limited's polished dark chrome and hot pink set. This, coupled with a custom in-house made Himeji leather rally strap, really pulls the piece together for an almost cyber punk / night race look that's somehow bold and yet contrastingly casual; both eccentric and still somehow relaxed. NOTE: These will take a little over a week to create and ship out - usually about 8-10 days. Full Aevum Track Tech Frost and Pink Limited chronograph specifications: Dimensions: 43mm x 48mm case with 20mm lug width, 12.8mm thick on the wrist (including sapphire crystal in measurement) Case: 316L stainless steel with brushed and polished accents Movement: VK64 Japanese mecha-quartz chronograph movement with 1/5 second chronograph hand and mechanical flyback return features Water resistance: The Track Tech has a unique wheel face tire tread grip screw down crown and is water resistant up to 200 Meters (20ATM) Crystal: Sapphire crystal with blue tinge anti-reflection coating Dial: Matte finished with 2x Super Luminova C1(green glow) lumed applied indices and hands Case back: Screw down case back with double crossed wrench artwork. Leather strap: The Track Tech chronograph comes with one 100% handmade by us in-house three hole rally leather strap in your choice of grey or white finish. Our leather straps are built 120mm/75mm long and taper from 20mm to 18mm at the laser engraved Aevum buckle Nylon strap: Great for taking your Track Tech into wet conditions Leather carry case: All Track Tech's come with a beautiful hand made by us leather carry case that's matched to your Track Tech Please be aware that while the watch is built, the straps and carry cases are handmade for this model and can take up to two weeks to complete.

watches.name: The Pure Ti
watches.description: Titanium, heat, and craftsmanship — that's the entire concept of the Pure Ti. Case, chapter ring, dial and case back are all hand-turned from grade 5 titanium on the lathe, then the dial, chapter ring and case back hand-torch coloured. That blue-to-violet shift across the dial isn't printed or plated. It's pulled straight out of the metal with heat, so no two ever end up quite the same. The linear brushed finish underneath keeps the finish from going too shiny or glassy, letting the color show without the glaze. Simple as the dial looks, that's the part that's genuinely hard to get right. Nothing on it to hide behind, so every brush pass and every second under the torch has to work. Dark chrome hands carry BGW9 lume, and even the "Pure Ti" text is hand pad printed in a BGW9 infused white ink, so the logo glows as well. The strap is Himeji Kurozan leather with urushi lacquered tips, old Japanese leatherwork on a case built with new skill, built one at a time, by hand, in a garage in Osaka. watches.name: The Touge Racer
watches.description: The Touge Racer sits right where Aevum's road ends and Garage Hira's begins. The case shape carries something new entirely with the massive radial bezel that gives you the impression of Mt Fuji from a side view. Every line on that face is laser-cut and painted by hand, built around the kind of manga panel energy you'd find in a touge battle scene — speed lines pulling toward the apex, ドン and ギャァア breaking through like sound effects lifted straight off the page. It's not printed or stamped; it's engraved into the steel itself, so the artwork has real depth under the light. The pink seconds hand cuts through the monochrome just enough to keep your eye moving, and the iridescent blue-to-purple bezel shifts with it depending on the angle you're catching it from. It's going to be small run, hand-finished top to bottom, ever changing in the layout and it carries the first Garage Hira (平) mark, the moment the brand started becoming what it is now. The white brass dial is made entirely in-house. Hand brushed, hand painted and hand lumed with Nemoto BGW9. A dial that pulls you in with the curve of the road. Paired with a Kurozan urushi tipped Japanese leather strap and an NH35 automatic movement, the Touge Racer is a handmade tribute to Japan's racing spirit, craftmanship and the entertainment that pulls it all together. specsRaw.Movement: NH-35 automatic 3 hand movement with a 41 hour power reserve.
specsRaw.Crystal: thick double domed and high chamfered sapphire crystal with blue tinge anti-reflection coating.
specsRaw.Dial: In-house hand made and hand brushed turbo fan design with dark chrome hands. Completely lumed by hand with Nemoto BGW9 (blue glow).
specsRaw.Crown: 7mm Aevum double-wrench artwork and high grip knurled crown. Screw down triple gasket design.
specsRaw.Case back: Handmade lathe turned screw down case back with hand torched blue finish that locks down a 0.8mm compression gasket for water resistance.
specsRaw.Leather strap: The Touge Racer Titanium Automatic comes with one 100% handmade by us in-house Japanese urushi tipped leather strap with quick release spring bars. It is tapered from 20mm to 18mm at the laser engraved Aevum buckle.
specsRaw.Carry case: All Touge Racer Titanium Automatics come with a ABS plastic travel box with an in-house laser engraved top plate.
